g.text: 2026-11-08 · paired Linux x86-64 SVM · O2 · serial GC · no PGO · production 9a1dcec → e4cec9f
Bars: median of three fresh-process medians; whiskers: full min–max, not confidence intervals.
Isolated preserved images; separate workloads/hosts. These captures predate final release fixes and packaging.
Warm-read gains do not imply decode gains. Owning resident ranges retain the 17.4 µs candidate outlier.
Scoped session retains an 855.6 B native arena/row in this fixture; Java allocation excludes native storage and transient peaks.
Image SHA-256 prefixes: baseline 0d1d7dd37490 / candidate c521a028d076; exact hashes in comparison-manifest.json.
